description: A sheet of plywood by the ops desk, hand-lettered in three colours of paint marker: NO MANIFESTS. NO QUESTIONS. CASH ON THE SKID. Below it, a pinned drift of curling paper — fuel debts, a couple of grease-thumbed charts of dead-reckoning lines out over the scrub, a faded flyer for a fight that happened years ago, and a short list of names with lines drawn firmly through them. You don't ask what the lines mean.
name: the ops board
